CHAPTER.VERS: When Yeshua had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and proclaim in their cities.
Now when Yochanan heard in the prison the works of Messiah, he sent two of his disciples
and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
As these went their way, Yeshua began to say to the multitudes concerning Yochanan,
Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
